breakfast.name: Kaya Toast (Singaporean Coconut Jam Toast)
breakfast.description: Classic Singaporean breakfast of toast with silky coconut egg jam (kaya) and cold salted butter, traditionally served with half-boiled eggs and black coffee or tea
instructions: Make kaya toast: Toast bread slices in toaster or over charcoal until golden brown
Using serrated knife, carefully split each toasted slice in half horizontally
Expose steamy interior
Smear approximately 1.5 tbsp kaya generously on one half of toast
Top with slab of cold salted butter
Close sandwich with other toast half
Cut diagonally in half
Serve immediately
Make half-boiled eggs: Bring water to rolling boil in pot
Carefully place eggs in boiling water
Cook for 6-7 minutes to achieve soft-boiled eggs with runny yolks
Transfer immediately to ice bath to stop cooking
Gently tap and peel eggs
Place in small bowl or egg cup
Season with soy sauce and white pepper
Serve alongside kaya toast with black coffee or tea
Soft yolk can be mixed with seasonings and eaten with spoon
Toast pieces can be dipped into egg yolk
breakfast.notes: Kaya is custard-like spread made from coconut milk, eggs, sugar, and pandan leaves. Can substitute with homemade kaya or store-bought versions
breakfast.fun_fact: Kaya toast is classic Singaporean breakfast found in every kopi tiam (coffee house). The traditional serving includes half-boiled eggs and black coffee (Kopi-O)

lunch.name: Laksa (Spiced Noodle Soup)
lunch.description: Popular Singaporean lunch - rich, spiced coconut broth with noodles and seafood or chicken
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in pot, add laksa paste and fry for 2 minutes until fragrant
Add coconut milk and broth, bring to simmer
Cook protein until done, add to soup
Cook rice noodles separately according to package
Divide noodles into bowls
Pour hot laksa broth over noodles
Top with egg, bean sprouts, cilantro, basil and fried tofu
Serve with lime wedge on side
lunch.notes: Laksa paste is essential - can be store-bought or homemade. Coconut milk creates rich, smooth base
lunch.fun_fact: Laksa is popular Singaporean lunch with many regional variations throughout Southeast Asia
